original_content_full: The paper "Art-directable Stroke-based Rendering on Mobile Devices" by Ronja Wagner,Sebastian Schulz, Max Reimann, Amir Semmo, Jürgen Döllner, and Matthias Trapp was accepted for publication at the 28th International International Symposium on Vision, Modeling, and Visualization (VMV 2023). The conference will take place in Braunschweig, Germany from September 27th to 29th. For more information, visit the website.
